title: wg: room-policy-04 capability registry has two names
description: draft-ietf-mimi-room-policy-04 calls the registry 'MIMI Capability Types IANA registry' in the §3 and Appendix B comment but 'MIMI Role Capabilities' in §10.2. Editorial, no wire effect. Report to the MIMI WG.
notes: Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED editorial: 'MIMI Capability Types' vs 'MIMI Role Capabilities' registry.
